newsitem.title: USA: Plasti-Line gets GM sign contracts.
newsitem.headline: Plasti-Line gets GM sign contracts.

text.p: Plasti-Line Inc. said on Tuesday that General Motors Corp. has awarded the company an $80 million contract to administer signs for more than 8,000 car dealerships in the United States.

The supply contract extends through Jan. 1, 2004 and replaces a contract that had expired on Dec. 31, 1995. Plasti-line officials were not immediately available to say why there was no contract in 1996 and the first part of 1997.

The service agreement is GM's plan to contract out administration of its sign programme, Knoxville, Tenn.-based Plasti-Line said. Plasti-Line will absorb lease administration for the dealerships throughout the United States, it said.
